title: fix(worker): answer the app-server status probe from the worker
context:
The Codex transport lives in the worker, not the dashboard, because
_control_plane_routes_engines() defaults on. Routing system.app_server
through the control plane means the status panel reports the app-server
the sessions actually use, instead of the dashboard's idle view of it.
